boundary_artefact.interpretation: If HB reduces continuous loss / CVaR / mean dECE but raises the binary harm rate, and the new harm events cluster within +-0.003 of the 0.002 margin, then the H1 failure is a threshold artefact of the proxy, not a degradation of the calibration estimator.

conclusion_honesty: This does NOT overturn H1. H1 remains FAILED per PREREGISTRATION_W9.md section 6. It only diagnoses why, and motivates a pre-registered continuous endpoint in W10.
